title: redundancy reserve allocation heatmap Q3 2026
summary: Operational capacity sheet for Q3 2026 focusing on spare capacity, cross-region failover readiness, and DR reserve allocations. Purpose: give SRE and capacity planners a single-pane view of regional spare pools, recommended reserve targets, and immediate actions to reach target redundancy for our hosted and dedicated customers.
assumptions: 1) Peak week traffic forecasts from Product (forecast id: PROD-FCST-Q3-2026) assumed 18% QoQ growth. 2) Average per-request GPU token consumption uses historical distribution (75% short-form, 25% long-form). 3) Autoscaling to burst pools is available but cross-region startup time is 6-12 minutes. 4) Reserved DR pools must be cold-warm for cost reasons: start-up SLA target 10 minutes for critical tiers, 30 minutes for best-effort.

compute_notes: - Spare_pct is current_spare_count / total_gpus. - target_reserve_count set to provide N+1 failover for 95% of target traffic windows. - Backup-pool in us-central1 is intended to be the neutral DR pool; kept at higher spare percentage for fast lifts. - H100 pools prioritized for latency SLOs; when failing over use model-quantized A100 variants where possible.
heatmap_observations: 1) Us-east1 and backup-pool currently meet target reserve counts. 2) Us-west1 and europe-west1 spare pools are adequate but show rising utilization during black-friday test runs. 3) Asia pools are under provisioned for DR: asia-east1 H100 pool not registered for automatic KV state transfer; needs engineering work. 4) Overall fleet spare = 18% which is below our recommended 22% for Q3 given forecast growth.
immediate_actions: - Queue infra ticket INFRA-2170 to register asia-east1 H100s with KV transfer and test with canary failover run (owner: Daniel Nguyen). - Rebalance 12 A100-40GB from us-west1 to backup-pool (planned move window: 2026-03-22 02:00-06:00 UTC). - Increase backup-pool cold-warm target from 30% -> 60% by reserving additional 15 instances (financial approval required). - Schedule cross-region failover drill (DR drill id: DR-DRILL-Q3-2026) for 2026-04-05.
risk_assessment: - Financial: raising backup reserves increases monthly committed cost by estimated $42k. - Operational: Asia failover inability could cause 8-12 minute increased tail latency for APAC customers during region outage. - Security/Compliance: movement of EU customer traffic into backup-pool must be filtered by data residency policies before failover; requires Product signoff.
